== Summary ==
[[Yannick Lapointe]] in the post-match interview after the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Final Confrontation, [[DecipherCon 2000]] (7 October 2000). Video still at 0:29.

* '''Source:''' [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A&t=29s DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios), YouTube (21 August 2018), at 0:29. Footage by Derek Brooks.
* '''Preserved copy:''' [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive]
* '''Credit:''' Derek Brooks (video)
* '''Identification:''' the interview has two players, Lapointe and [[Matt Sokol]]. Sokol is the player in the light shirt and tan cap, matching [[:File:Team Albany 2000 Team Championship.jpg]] from the same weekend, so the player in the black shirt, black cap and glasses is Lapointe.
